thread:
maria: Quick async — launching FlagGate canary on staging-1 at 10% (us-west). Plan: smoke checks for gen/embed paths, 15m observation window, then ramp to 50% if clean. Ping here with any regressions or 5xx spikes. @alex @sam @irene

alex: saw steady p95 for /v1/generate, ~220ms (baseline ~210ms). GPU util on pool-B up ~6%. No errors in trace s: rtrk_9a2b. :thumbsup:

sam: running embeds smoke suite now. first run hit a 500 on /v1/embeds for a long input. frequency so far 1/12. collecting logs.

ops-bot: Alert at 11:22:31: pool-B instance i-0a3f restarted, 502 spike for ~90s. Related?

irene: I can flip fallback to cpu-quantized for pool-B if this is noisy. Which variant is the canary running?

dev-bot: Deploy note: canary flag "flaggate.embeds.v2" toggled -> 10% at 1710618452 by maria.

sam: repro + logs attached below. Repro steps (local):
```bash
curl -X POST https://staging.api.redwood/v1/embeds \\n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TEST_KEY' \\n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \\n  -d '{"input": "'$(python -c 'print("x"*4500)')'"}'
```
Trace id for failed request: rtrk_7f4c. Error snippet: `HTTP 500: upstream read timeout`

alex: digging into trace rtrk_7f4c now. prelim shows request landed on pod pool-B-3 which restarted during the request window. Could be noisy node.

maria: ok — plan update: irene please flip fallback to cpu-quantized for pool-B only, keep canary flag on so we can still observe behavior in other pools. Sam keep running repros and post any new trace ids. If no new failures by 11:40 PT we ramp to 50%.

irene: done — fallback flipped for pool-B at 1710618720.

ops-bot: pool-B restart count dropped to 0 after restart remediation.

sam: rerun 10 cycles after fallback flip: 0 failures so far (10/10). avg latency for embeds path ~130ms.

alex: traces look clean after fallback. no queued KV-cache errors. rolling metrics look stable.

maria: thanks team. proceeding to ramp to 50% at 1710618980. watch for regressions over next 10m.

dev-bot: Canary ramp to 50% completed at 1710618985.

maria: closing loop — no further errors reported by 1710619120. keeping flag open and monitoring for 24h. will create a short follow-up doc for post-mortem if we see re-occurrence. :white_check_mark:
